propositions: Git 2.38+ is required for `git merge-tree --write-tree` capability used by the two-clone enrichment regression (bug 8185).
The repository lacks explicit declaration of the Git version floor, allowing tests to run on unsupported older clients without clear error.
A runtime skip guard would mask the regression test silently on older clients, repeating the vacuous test rot seen in prior guards (34c2, 8a5e-b88e-0c3e-4544).
The Git floor must be enforced via session-level pytest abort (never skip) with diagnostic naming the required version, installed version, and capability.
The floor declaration must be single-sourced (`.github/git-version-floor.txt`) and enforced in conftest, CI workflow, and contributor documentation to prevent drift.
The 8185 regression must remain collected and executed on every gating CI environment (ubuntu-latest, macos-latest) without conditional skip paths.
